judgement.reason: PostHog needs several application services that must run together, including a separate Node.js services image built from Dockerfile.node, and it also relies on ClickHouse and Kafka, which Deployz does not provide.

evidence.quote: # Node.js services are built separately using Dockerfile.node.
[PostHog](https://posthog.com/) ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.
